answer: Each identity joins one twenty-member haven district, locking a 50-credit bond keyed to the district willow roster tree. Each epoch a whisper roll-call requires each member's own-key answer, hashed into the willow root for replay. A missed or key-mismatched answer burns the bond. A charter costs 100 plus 20 more per district the same funder already chartered, so the 1000th fake pays 50 plus 1080, and 1000 fakes cost 79,500 credits. Rented districts fail: the whisper answer carries the renter's key, not the roster key, so the bond burns. An honest agent joins one open district and pays 50 once.
